LanguageData.OL_Editor_Note: Pawns wear the best allowed piece, judged stat by stat from the top.
LanguageData.OL_Editor_Help: Pawns compare clothes on the first line, then the next. Lock items in the slot browser to keep them over the stats. What's allowed is set on the Allowed items tab.
LanguageData.OL_Editor_BaseTip: Another policy this one builds on. Its locked items and limits apply here too, and its stats go under this policy's own. Other allowed items aren't shared.
LanguageData.OL_Editor_DirectionTip: Click to switch between preferring higher and lower values.
LanguageData.OL_Layer_Tip: Which layers this stat counts on. A piece only counts on this line when it's on one of them, and so does anything it would replace.
LanguageData.OL_Editor_LockedItemTip: Pawns wear {0} over anything not locked, in any material and quality, and it stays allowed. Lock or unlock items in the slot browser, or remove this line to unlock it. Click for its info card.
LanguageData.OL_Editor_LocksFirst: Locked items stay above the stats.
LanguageData.OL_Lock_KeptAllowed: {0} is locked, so it stays allowed. Unlock it first.
LanguageData.OL_Editor_Empty: No stats yet. Pawns pick clothes the usual way.
LanguageData.OL_Forbid_Note: Apparel that misses a limit is unticked in Allowed items. Order doesn't matter.
LanguageData.OL_Forbid_Empty: No limits yet. Everything ticked in Allowed items can be worn.
LanguageData.OL_Forbid_HeadingTip: Each limit is a minimum or maximum on one stat. Apparel that misses one is unticked in this policy's Allowed items, judged in its usual material at normal quality. Pawns take off what's unticked, and items tick back once they meet every limit. Items unticked by hand stay unticked, and locked items are never unticked.
LanguageData.OL_Forbid_DirectionTip: Click to switch between a minimum (at least) and a maximum (at most).
LanguageData.OL_Forbid_LayerTip: Which layers this limit covers. Apparel on other layers isn't held to it.
LanguageData.OL_StatPicker_ChangedBy: {0} apparel items give this to their wearer.
LanguageData.OL_StatPicker_HadBy: {0} apparel items have a value for this.
